cues.text: You and Akihiko come running in through the door of the dorm and pull up, out of breath.
Akihiko notices a large parcel in the lounge, walks over to it and reads the label.
Later, the dorm is gathered in the lounge around the open parcel on the table, Yukari, Junpei, Mitsuru and Fuuka among them. Akihiko sits in an armchair with his arms folded.
Everyone eats and talks together. Later, with most of the food gone, Akihiko stands beside you by the parcel.
Akihiko looks down into the box with a start, then his face falls.
